goal: Frontal catch-light on the room lighting station for seated patients, so the portrait lab shows an iris catch-light.
method: Added one frontal 'catchlight' area source to designLightingRig (packages/openclinxr/factory-stations/src/lighting_design/run.ts), placed from the patient cast anchor (0,0.5,1) at the recorded rigRequirement band, regenerated the ob_triage_room_v1 rig through the station runner, then rendered the isolated-subject lab with the light on and off and diffed L*.

stationRule.rule: one 'area' light, name 'catchlight', per seated cast member (actorId /patient/i and cast z >= 0.8 m). Position = cast anchor + 2.0 m along the frontal axis, elevation 49.0 deg, azimuth 0 deg; target = cast anchor; size 0.35; 5000K.

numberSources.elevation: catchlight-key-report.json rigRequirement.perSubject intersection: aisha 48.5-67.0, body2 47.0-50.0 -> 48.5-50.0; 49.0 = midpoint
numberSources.distance: chosen so the source stays inside the ob_triage_room_v1 footprint 6.0 x 4.8 x 2.65 (z 2.5094 <= 2.65, y -0.8121 >= -2.4)

stationRule.revertReason: FALSIFIER fired (see measurement): the rig light is not visible through the lab's catch-light path, so the rule was reverted per the card. See requiredWiring.

rigRegeneration.command: pnpm tsx .openclinxr/regenerate-catchlight-rigs.ts ob_triage_room_v1 (calls the station runner runLightingDesign; ephemeral, gitignored)
rigRegeneration.reproducedShippedRig: the first 7 lights reproduce the shipped ob_triage_room_v1.rig.json byte-identically; only the catchlight block was appended (8 lights)

spotDefinition: in-disc pixels (iris circle = darkCoreCircle L*<45 comp x1.15) whose (L_on - L_off) >= 25, peaked at the max-delta pixel in a +-45px eye rect (catchlight-key-report.json spotDefinition)

measurement.baseline: the same render with the 'catchlight' light hidden by userData.openClinXrLightingRigRole === 'catchlight' (hiddenLights=1); all other rig lights identical

runtimeCeiling.note: MAX_THREE_INTENSITY = 5 (apps/ui-xr/src/lighting-rig-runtime.ts); equals the rig MAX_RIG_ENERGY = 500 at energy*0.01

overCeiling.note: 4x the reachable ceiling; unrealisable through the rig. Proves the punctual path stays below the spot threshold even far outside the rig's range.

measurement.conclusion: The punctual contribution scales with intensity and reaches only ~10.5 L* at the reachable ceiling; the iris spot threshold is 25. No energy reachable by the rig makes the added source visible as a catch-light. FALSIFIER fired -> station rule reverted.

rootCause.labCatchLightPath: packages/openclinxr/xr-scene/src/isolated-subject-rig-variants.ts:363-380 sets material.envMap = PMREM(new RoomEnvironment(), 0.04) on the globe material and a procedural iris-disc roughnessMap; the catch-light is the scoped envMap reflection. Scene punctual lights are ignored by that path.
rootCause.removedModule: packages/openclinxr/xr-scene/src/cornea-env/rig-key-globe-env.ts (git 324890e64) rebuilt that env from the rig lights (7 loci); removed in fffa8648c with its call site in isolated-subject-rig-variants.ts restored to RoomEnvironment. That is why the rig key (70deg overhead) put the reflection under the upper lid and why a scene light does nothing.

requiredWiring.change: replace new RoomEnvironment() in the globe env with a rig-built env (the 8th frontal locus), i.e. restore packages/openclinxr/xr-scene/src/cornea-env/rig-key-globe-env.ts and call it here
requiredWiring.status: OUTSIDE WRITE_ROOTS: the card says the catch-light path may not be re-wired, so this is stopped and reported, not changed
